column2: Paano i-setup ang MSW para sa tests?
column4: npx msw init src/ — i-setup ang mocks. gumawa ng handlers at i-configure sa test setup file
import { rest } from 'msw'; import { setupServer } from 'msw/node'; const server = setupServer(rest.get('/api/users', (req, res, ctx) => res(ctx.json([...]))));
server.use(rest.get('/api', (req, res, ctx) => res(ctx.status(500)))); — i-simulate ang server error

column2: Paano i-integrate ang MSW sa tests?
column4: beforeAll(() => server.listen()); afterEach(() => server.resetHandlers()); afterAll(() => server.close());

column2: Paano pumili ng unit vs integration test?
column4: unit: i-isolate ang component. integration: i-test ang interaction ng components at data flow.
